name: SurveyMars
description: SurveyMars is a comprehensive platform designed to create, distribute, and analyze surveys with ease. It offers robust tools for gathering insights and feedback, making it ideal for businesses, educators, and researchers.

events.d: Create one or more contact groups by name, optionally assigning a parent group.

events.n: When a new survey response is submitted
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new response is submitted to a survey.
Create a new survey from a selected template, set its title, and optionally copy template settings.
Use AI to generate a ready-to-use survey from a title, purpose, language, number of questions, and survey type.
Get details for a specific AI-created survey.

events.n: When a new survey is created
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new survey is created in the account.
Find surveys using filters, sorting, and pagination.
Create a new contact with name, email, phone, admin role, group membership, labels, and custom fields.
Pause a survey so it stops accepting responses until resumed.
Publish a survey to make it live and available to respondents; optionally enable link sharing.
